description:
Position: PeopleSoft nVision Developer 
 Location: St. Paul, MN 
 Duration: 6 Months 
 
 Only local candidates as F2F interview is required 
 
 MUST HAVE: 
 · 10+ years’ experience with PeopleSoft developer roles 
 · 2+ years’ combined experience with PeopleSoft 9.2 FMS or SCM applications in a public sector environment 
 · Experience as a technical SME in PeopleSoft enterprise development 
 · 1 PeopleSoft version 9.2 implementation or upgrade project deployed 
 · 5+ years’ experience with nVision development 
 · 1+ years’ experience with nVision on PeopleTools 8.54 or higher 
 
 NICE TO HAVE: 
 
 · Experience in full lifecycle upgrades/implementations of PeopleSoft 9.1 or higher in a public sector environment 
 · Experience with data warehouse solutions including PeopleSoft EPM and Oracle OBIEE 
 · Experience with PeopleTools 8.55 
 · Experience with Fluid User Interface/Branding 
 · Experience with Fluid Development 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
